title: DNS
subtitle: The network's DNS server sends the game CDN names to lanstash

older.title: This lanstash has no DNS page yet
older.hint: The lanstash this page talks to is older than the page; the DNS page comes with its next update.

signIn: Shown only: changing the DNS setup needs an account that may manage DNS

done.tested: The test worked. {{server}} answered: {{rewrites}}; nothing was saved.

untrusted.label: An untrusted certificate
untrusted.trustLabel: Trust this certificate and test again
untrusted.text: The server's certificate is not trusted (self-signed, or not for this name). Its SHA-256 is {{fingerprint}}. If that is your server's, trust this one certificate: lanstash then accepts exactly it.

summary.label: How the names stand
summary.headline: {{fixed}} of {{wanted}}
summary.caption: game CDN names {{server}} sends to lanstash at {{answer}}

form.kindHelp: The DNS server your network uses.
form.addressHelp: Its host name or IP address, without http://.
form.connectionHelp: How its admin page is reached: plain HTTP, or HTTPS when it has a certificate.

trustHelp.check: It must be issued by a public authority (such as Let's Encrypt) for this address.
trustHelp.pin: Only the certificate with this SHA-256 is accepted: for a self-signed one.
trustHelp.none: Any certificate is accepted: still encrypted, but someone on the network could pose as the server and read lanstash's password.

form.userHelp: The admin user lanstash signs in as.
form.passwordHelp: Kept by lanstash where only it can read it; never shown again.
form.passwordHelpOf: {{kind}}'s web password (or an app password). Kept by lanstash where only it can read it; never shown again.
form.answerHelp: The IP address your PCs reach lanstash at. Empty: the one your rewrites of its names already lead to.

pointAtHelp.name: Every game name points at this name, and this name at lanstash's address: one rewrite to change if the address ever does. Add creates its rewrite when it has none.
pointAtHelp.address: Every game name points straight at lanstash's address.

form.name: Name
form.buttonsHelp: Test tries the setup without keeping it; Save tries it, then keeps it.
form.cancelLabel: Leave the setup as it is

rewrites.title: Rewrites
rewrites.note: {{server}}: Add only adds rewrites answering {{answer}} and merges duplicates; nothing else changes
rewrites.fromRewrites: the one your rewrites already use
rewrites.stand: {{fixed}} of {{wanted}} names lanstash wants are rewritten to {{answer}} ({{from}}).
rewrites.viaMissing: {{via}} has no rewrite yet: Add creates it, to {{answer}}
rewrites.name: Name
rewrites.notOursTitle: It points at lanstash but is on none of lanstash's lists: left alone
rewrites.totalRuled: {{n}} sent to lanstash by {{server}}'s rules (no rewrite added)
rewrites.totalNotOurs: {{n}} pointing at lanstash for another name (left alone)
